purpose: Test whether losses in the frozen non-promotable V5 candidate stream can be identified before entry and removed at sufficient precision to create a stable high-PF strategy.

base_candidate_stream.source: The five-sleeve V5 fallback configuration frozen from 2024 before 2025 and 2026 were read.
base_candidate_stream.loss_filter_applied: After the frozen primary score gate and before sleeve-level one-position handling.

causal_inputs.features: Frozen V5 compact M1 microstructure core features available at decision_time.
additional_inputs: frozen primary model raw probability prediction
frozen primary score minus numeric gate threshold

training.2024_risk_model: 2023 resolved rows only from the five selected sleeves, regardless of whether they passed the later 2024 primary gate.
training.2025_risk_model: Rows with decision_time before 2025-01-01 and relevant exit_time at or before 2025-01-01.
training.2026_risk_model: Rows with decision_time before 2026-01-01 and relevant exit_time at or before 2026-01-01.
training.sample_weight: clip(abs(strong_r),0.25,2.0) divided by same-sleeve rows in the same 30-minute decision bucket
training.purged_2023_oof: Three expanding folds with six-hour purge

causal_score_calibration.2024: Risk predictions ranked against matching 2023 purged OOF risk predictions.
causal_score_calibration.2025: Risk predictions ranked against complete 2024 out-of-sample risk predictions from the frozen through-2023 risk model.
causal_score_calibration.2026: Risk predictions ranked against complete 2025 out-of-sample risk predictions from the frozen through-2024 risk model.

2024_selection.evaluation_order: Primary score gate, loss-risk pruning, then independent sleeve one-position.
selection_order: higher minimum of Strong PF and Extreme PF

oracle_diagnostic.purpose: Quantify the theoretical PF ceiling if the same prune fraction removed the worst actual losses first, showing how much loss-identification precision is required.
